help.title: JRXML Visual Designer User Guide
help.basicsText: This tool is used to visually design PDF report templates for JasperReports, allowing you to quickly create professional PDF reports through drag and drop.

steps.modifyText: Open the bottom panel, copy the current JRXML into the code area, then click Apply
steps.addText: Drag elements from the element library on the left into the design area
steps.layoutText: Drag elements to reposition them, and drag the handles to resize them
steps.propertiesText: After selecting an element, set its properties in the right-hand panel
steps.dataText: Add report parameters and data fields in the left-hand panel
steps.generateText: Click the "Generate JRXML" button to export the report template

uses.UPCA: Retail products in the US and Canada
uses.UPCE: Small packs in the US and Canada
uses.PDF417: ID cards, boarding passes, transport documents

formats.EAN13: 12 digits; a 13th check digit is optional.
formats.EAN8: 7 digits; an 8th check digit is optional.
formats.UPCA: 11 digits; a 12th check digit is optional.
formats.UPCE: 7 digits starting with 0 or 1; an 8th check digit is optional.
formats.Code128: Letters, digits and symbols, without accents.
formats.EAN128: GS1 data: a number code then its value, e.g. 01 and a 14-digit item number.
formats.Code39: Capital letters A–Z, digits, spaces and - . $ / + %
formats.Codabar: Digits and - $ : / . +, with optional start and stop letters a–d.
formats.QRCode: Any text, such as a web address.
formats.RoyalMailCustomer: Capital letters A–Z and digits, without spaces.
formats.USPSIntelligentMail: 20 digits, plus an optional 5, 9 or 11-digit ZIP code.

problems.codabarEnds: Start and stop letters are optional; if you use them, put a lowercase a–d at both ends.
problems.uspsLength: Use 20 digits, plus an optional 5, 9 or 11-digit ZIP code.
